title: Tunisian Grilled Chicken with Clotted Cream
description: A flavorful and refreshing Tunisian dish that combines the taste of grilled chicken, creamy clotted cream, and energizing ingredients to create a delightful meal.

ingredients.name: Tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern stores

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Tunisian spice blend, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breasts.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together clotted cream and lemon juice.
Serve the grilled chicken with the clotted cream sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with grated energizing ginger and a sprinkle of black pepper.
